scope.school: Fudan University School of Social Development and Public Policy (SSDPP)

method: Read-only public web-index searches; no Edge or authenticated Zhihu/WeChat/Xiaohongshu site search. Only roster course names and teacher names sourced from work/ssdpp-research/live-jobs/targets.json. Search-result blocks and snippets are discovery aids; they were not treated as full text. Candidate URLs are not confirmed reviews until the actual page is read and matches course, instructor, institution, timing and student-review context.

course_plus_teacher.method_note: Initial 100 query pass only; each query used official full course title and teacher full names as OR alternatives; not all 296 course codes were covered by this combined form.

teacher_only.individual_result_attribution: not reliable; links were returned as four-query batch-level result groups

platform_findings.zhihu: returned candidate URLs; many unrelated/general pages; not yet article-level classroom-review hits
platform_findings.xiaohongshu: some indexed pages, mainly platform/vendor/admin or unrelated pages; no validated course-review hit
platform_findings.wechat: no direct mp.weixin.qq.com URL in captured teacher-query links; this records index output only, not absence of in-platform content

discovery_result: No direct student-authored, in-scope course review was validated in the captured public-index output. This is an index-based finding only; it does not prove that target-site or authenticated content does not exist.
